verdict.rationale: Scheduled or continuous background scanning is a fair capability for a security scanner, so the axis applies. However, the evidence shows only on-demand CLI scans and an MCP server for natural-language queries. Community remarks that Trivy is easy to wire into CI or to 'write automation around' describe user-side or host-platform arrangements, not a product feature for setting up autonomous recurring automations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
